name: BOSS DR12 galaxy clustering cosmological analysis

summary.plain: The final galaxy-clustering analysis of BOSS, using 1.2 million galaxies, measured cosmic distances and the growth of structure. Combined with Planck, the results strongly affirm a spatially flat universe with a cosmological constant.
summary.technical: BOSS DR12: 1.2 million massive galaxies over 9329 deg² (volume 18.7 Gpc³) at effective redshifts 0.38, 0.51, 0.61; BAO DM and H after reconstruction, AP DM·H and fσ8 from RSD (6% precision). With Planck 2015: ΩK = 0.0003 ± 0.0026 and w = -1.01 ± 0.06.

title: The clustering of galaxies in the completed SDSS-III Baryon Oscillation Spectroscopic Survey: cosmological analysis of the DR12 galaxy sample
why_it_matters: The abstract says the combined distance and growth measurements are tighter and more robust than any single method and strongly affirm the spatially flat cold dark matter model with a cosmological constant.
